In 2024 I gave a webinar for the Learning Bayesian Statistics series on non-parametric causal inference — covering propensity scores, debiased ML, and causal mediation with PyMC. The slides can be found [here](https://nathanielf.github.io/talks/lbs_non_param_causal/non_param_causal.html#/title-slide).

The recording is available on YouTube.
